name: HINAR Dessert Bar & Cafe
notes: not_found. The work-list website hinardessertbarcafe.shop 301-redirects to hinar-dessert-bar-cafe.placejoys.com, a hard-reject directory farm (placejoys.com is explicitly barred) that serves an empty templated /menu page with zero prices. Also found hinar-dessert-bar-cafe.weeblyte.com, another known fabricated-listing network domain (weeblyte is explicitly barred). This is the second HINAR location ('HINAR Dessert Bar & Cafe 2', Scripps Ranch Marketplace) confirmed via Google Maps at the exact work-list address (10755 Scripps Poway Pkwy, San Diego, CA 92131) - a different, unrelated address (454 13th St, downtown) belongs to the original HINAR location and its menupix/sagemenu/Yelp listings were not used for that reason. Checked: own site (farm redirect, no prices), joe.coffee listing (marketing page only, no menu/order link with prices), DoorDash search from a San Diego default address (not listed), Yelp (403 to curl; menu tab is barred by policy regardless and dated-photo tab could not be reached in the time available). Web search only turned up two anecdotal per-item prices from customer reviews (cake slice ~$12, latte ~$5-7) with no structured per-dish menu anywhere, and one reviewer explicitly noted the shop had no visible prices until recently. No priced source with individual dish-level pricing exists online for this location.

notes: The restaurant's own site (twobrothersfromitalypizza.com) has no menu page of its own, only an 'Order Here' link to order.online (DoorDash's white-label platform). The San Marcos store (591 Grand Ave, address confirmed exactly) was selected from a 4-location picker on order.online. Ran the markup division test (1.05-1.3) on all 93 priced items (23 distinct prices): no divisor clears more than 4/93, so there is no evidence of a uniform delivery-platform markup - prices are plain restaurant-style $X.50/$X.95/$X.00 endings. Held at medium per the ladder since order.online is checked, not trusted, even when it passes. All menu sections read by clicking through the category rail on the single continuously-loading page: Most Ordered/Featured, Oven Baked Subs, N.Y. Style Pizza, Sicilian Square Pizza, Salad, Specialty/Gourmet Pizzas, Pasta, Pasta Al Forno (Baked Pasta), Kids Pasta, Family Pasta Meal, Side Orders, Desserts. One category, 'Calzone (Italian version of pizza pocket)', rendered with a header and no items under it - unclear whether this is genuinely empty or unrendered; no per-category item count was exposed to settle it, so it is reported as unread rather than guessed.
